items.title: Ellis Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Lolis Elie, the father, he went there.

ctx.x: In the eighth grade. The following year I graduated and went to high school, the Methodist school, Gilbert Academy. I liked that school. It was more like a community, and the principal was the wife of a Methodist bishop. She was sort of like a mother hen with biddies. It was the same high school that Harold Battiste went to, except he was ahead of me. Andrew Young went to that school. Tom Dent went to that school. Lolis Elie, the father, he went there. It was a great school.
Did you continue on, once you go to this school, to get your high school diploma?
